# CODE Magazine

> > CODE Magazine: A leading software development publication and consulting firm specializing in .NET, AI solutions, Microsoft technologies, and enterprise application development.

CODE Magazine has been serving the developer community since its premier issue, offering in-depth technical articles, consulting services, and AI training. The company, operating as EPS Software, provides consulting services including AI Success Accelerators, Business Document Copilot, and custom application development with expertise in Microsoft Fabric, .NET, and cloud technologies.

## Key Topics

- .NET development
- Artificial Intelligence and AI consulting
- Microsoft Fabric
- Business Document Copilot
- CODE Labs
- Visual FoxPro (VFP)
- XML and web services
- COM and Windows DNA
- Distributed applications
- Copilot integration
- Cloud development
- Technical staffing and consulting
- Developer education and training
- Custom application development

- [CODE Online](https://codemag.com): Homepage for CODE Magazine, consulting, AI training, and dev services

- [Business Document Copilot](https://www.codemag.com/ai-docs): Business Document Copilot AI service for document processing

## Web Services and Distributed Applications

- [The Web at your service](https://codemag.com/Article/0003011/The-Web-at-your-service): Markus Egger and Rick Strahl on .NET web services with SOAP and XML
- [Using XML for Messaging in Distributed Applications (Part 1)](https://www.codemag.com/Article/0001031/Using-XML-for-Messaging-in-Distributed-Applications-Part-1): Rick Strahl on XML messaging in Visual FoxPro distributed apps
- [Using XML For Messaging In Distributed Applications (Part 2)](https://codemag.com/Article/0002031/Using-XML-For-Messaging-In-Distributed-Applications-Part-2): Rick Strahl on XML/XMLDOM data conversion in Visual FoxPro apps
- [XML Data Binding for IE5 clients](https://www.codemag.com/Article/0002041/XML-Data-Binding-for-IE5-clients): Jon Newell on client-side XML data binding in Internet Explorer 5

## COM and Windows DNA Architecture

- [Windows DNA Development: A Pattern Language](https://codemag.com/Article/0001041/Windows-DNA-Development-A-Pattern-Language): Yair Griver on Windows DNA architecture patterns with COM and MTS
- [Create Bulletproof Components with COM Security](https://codemag.com/Article/0002051/Create-Bulletproof-Components-with-COM-Security): Markus Egger on COM+ security model for Windows 2000 components
- [COM Queued Components](https://codemag.com/Article/0003021/COM-Queued-Components): Markus Egger on asynchronous messaging with COM+ and MSMQ
